text:
clare_prod: :loudspeaker: Quick announcement  updated On-Prem Emergency Hotpatch policy and rollback guidance will take effect 2026-08-01. Please read the summary below and flag any open questions. Full doc: https://go.redwood/onprem-hotpatch
diego_eng: Can you paste the short bullets for engineers and AE teams?
clare_prod: Sure  high level bullets:
clare_prod:  Emergency hotpatches: Critical security or data-loss fixes can be delivered as hotpatches to Private/VPC/on-prem customers who have signed the Emergency Support Addendum. Hotpatches are limited to minimal code deltas and must pass a 1-hr validation in staging where possible.
clare_prod:  Rollback policy: We provide an automated rollback artifact for each hotpatch. Customers may opt into automatic rollback escalation or manual rollback. Auto-rollback requires a scoped support tunnel and consent to session logs.
clare_prod:  Customer choices: "Auto-Rollback (consent)", "Manual-Rollback", or "Decline Hotpatches". Decline means only out-of-band guidance will be provided; no live patching.
clare_prod:  For air-gapped customers, we ship a signed hotpatch bundle that the customer applies locally; our support engineers can guide application but will not push code without explicit consent.
clare_prod:  Legacy customers without the addendum will receive security advisories and manual patch instructions but not automated hotpatch delivery.
diego_eng: Engineers: implementation notes for the runtime runtime-team: hotpatches are built as module deltas, signed with our release key, and include a deterministic verification step. We'll expose a dry-run flag.
diego_eng: Example apply flow (customer):
diego_eng: ```
# verify signature and dry-run
redwoodctl hotpatch verify ./patch.tar.gz --signature ./patch.sig
redwoodctl hotpatch apply ./patch.tar.gz --dry-run --timeout 15m
# apply for real (requires consent token for auto rollback)
redwoodctl hotpatch apply ./patch.tar.gz --consent "hotpatch-2026" --auto-rollback true
```
maria_compliance: Compliance notes: hotpatch bundles contain code deltas only; we never include customer data. For customers under strict change-control we will provide a traceable audit bundle and an approval workflow integration (SAML/OAuth) to capture approver metadata.
legal_ops: Legal: Customers must sign the Emergency Support Addendum to receive automated hotpatches. Exceptions for government/regulatory accounts handled via deviation. Route requests to legal_ops@redwood.com.
ops-bot: Policy created: HOTPATCH-2026 assigned to diego_eng and owen_support (due 2026-07-20).
owen_support: Support offering: we'll provide a "Hotpatch Assistance" paid SKU for customers who want hands-on guidance during apply/rollback windows. Add to quoting templates. Support will also publish a short troubleshooting playbook.
sara_sales: AE playbook request: can we get three one-liners for pitch?
sara_sales: 1) Auto-Rollback: "Quick fix with automatic rollback if issues detected; requires consent."
sara_sales: 2) Manual-Rollback: "Controlled apply with full customer approval steps."
sara_sales: 3) Decline Hotpatches: "Receive advisory and manual patch instructions only."
clare_prod: Great. Docs will include a short decision tree for customers and a matrix showing what each option means for SLA and liability. We'll publish by EOD Friday.
diego_eng: Monitoring note: hotpatch apply will emit structured events to the local audit log. If customer opts into upload, events can be sent to our diagnostics endpoint under the Observability Addendum. Otherwise logs are local only.
maria_compliance: Also: for customers in EU, we will include a consent record and TTL for any uploaded logs; retention capped by their selection and contract terms.
owen_support: Playbook items: 1) Pre-apply check (signature+dry-run). 2) 30-minute post-apply health checks. 3) If health checks fail, trigger rollback artifact automatically if enabled, otherwise follow manual rollback runbook.
legal_ops: Note re indemnity: hotpatches delivered under the addendum carry a limited warranty; full details in the addendum doc.
clare_prod: Action items: product/docs to publish guidance (due 2026-07-15), eng to finalize dry-run + verification (due 2026-07-10), sales/support to add SKUs and playbook (due 2026-07-20).
ops-bot: Announcement published: <https://go.redwood/onprem-hotpatch|onprem-hotpatch> by @clare_prod at 4159876543
sara_sales: Thanks all  I'll schedule a 20-min AE briefing tomorrow to walk through the decision tree.
clare_prod: Thanks team. If there are no objections we'll send customer outreach next week.
sara_sales: :thumbsup:
